events.summary: By Mari KaeyariApproaching BGs Hey guys, Mari Kaeyari here! I am the artist who did the BGs, miscellaneous assets and the polishing of the UI needed for Nozomu School Daze. I am preferably a character focused artist and have only done a handful of BGs for VN GameJams (Sealed with a Kiss 2025, Otome Jam 2025). events.title: Devlog #5: Writing and Coding Progress

Cero, our sprite artist, estimates that we are 60% done with all the art assets.So we are chugging along at a decent clip and planning for a Fall 2026 release.Don’t forget to WISHLIST the full game! Thanks for all your support!!-Maroon Ink Studio

events.title: Devlog #4: Nozomu School Daze Development Timeline
events.summary: To talk about the start of Nozomu School Daze, we'd have to go back, back…198x - Cass was born in the state of–Okay, maybe not that far back. events.title: Devlog #2: Free NSD Route on Itchio
events.summary: How would you like a FREE (partial) game? We participated in Itchio’s Otome Jam 2026, a two-month challenge in which contributors complete one storyline (route) of one of their visual novel’s love interests. So we wrote, scripted, and drew Julius’s route, posting it on Itchio for everyone to play for FREE – but only for a limited time!
